svg.title: Muktanan Mohapatra, tinySage
svg.desc: A bedside monitor. Patient MOHAPATRA, MUKTANAN, tinySage, CSE, ITER (SOA), Bhubaneswar. Message: Unconfirmed. Awaiting review by Maranello. Lead II shows a few beats that lift into the handwritten name Muktanan. HR 72 bpm, sinus rhythm. A small black cat with blue eyes and a green sprout on its head trots along the bottom edge, jumps up round the right side and sits on the top edge.
